parentGuardianManagedAssociation.workspaceCapacity: Same maximum of five retained Profile Workspaces per Wand Account; self and parent_guardian_managed count together; active and archived both count.

allowed: parent may select/manage a DreamSnaps candidate sourced from a parent_guardian_managed Workspace
parent may submit that candidate as the Wand Account's single final DreamSnaps entry for the round
parent and child may passively view DreamSnaps entries together
disallowedForChildManagedProfile: Gallery publication outside the post-result DreamSnaps lifecycle

productClosed: 13 is the minimum age for an independent Wand Account.
Independent registration by users under 13 is prohibited.
Accountless local save/editor functionality remains available regardless of Wand Account eligibility.

A parent or guardian may use their own Wand Account to create/manage a parent_guardian_managed DDV Profile Workspace for an under-13 user's game profile; no separate under-13 Wand credentials are created.
Parent-managed Workspaces use the same maximum-five retained Workspace capacity as self-managed Workspaces.
An under-13 managed profile is not an independent Community actor. Its only Community contribution path at launch is a DreamSnaps work submitted through the parent/guardian Wand Account.

Passive DreamSnaps viewing with the parent is allowed; the child-managed profile does not vote, react, comment, reply, follow, save/favorite, participate in Q&A/Tips, or publish other Community content.
After DreamSnaps results, non-text reactions and saves/favorites may be received on the work; comments/replies remain disabled for under-13-managed provenance at launch.
Public attribution uses the parent Creator Profile. Child Workspace identity and under-13-managed status remain private.
privacyLegalStillOpen: Final age-gate/age-assurance implementation and data minimization.

Minor-specific default privacy, safety and moderation requirements for independent users aged 13-17.

nonGoals: No age-verification provider is selected by this Product decision.
